config.board: Efinix Titanium Ti180 J484 Development Kit
config.accel_config: tinyml_core0_define.v resnet8-only: conv 16x8 STANDARD, ADD STANDARD, RS STANDARD, FC/MUL/LR/MIN_MAX DISABLE (FC in software), FIFOs 64/36, cache 4096, AXI_DW=512

metrics.end_to_end_note: host-limited by 115200-baud UART input path; not an engine number

notes: latency_ms = mean CLINT-timer delta around Invoke() only, per single inference over the accuracy slice. fps = N back-to-back Invoke() calls timed on-chip (input constant; UART excluded).
